(() => { document.activeElement?.blur(); const h = document.querySelector('.talk-held'); if (!h) return; h.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); let s = h.parentElement; while (s && !['auto','scroll'].includes(getComputedStyle(s).overflowY)) s = s.parentElement; const pill = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Latest')); if (s && pill && pill.getBoundingClientRect().top < h.getBoundingClientRect().bottom) s.scrollTop += h.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - pill.getBoundingClientRect().top + 8; })()
